note.label: Agree Together | Bound Not Bondage

precepts.why:
“For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints. Let your women keep silence in the churches”. Why does that follow right after God is not the author of confusion? Because a woman speaking out of turn concerning the church is confusion. A woman not being in order is confusion.

There is history behind why Paul said to let the women keep silence in the churches. Acts 19: “And it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus”. This is what was happening in that whole region of Corinth and Ephesus.

The craftsmen feared “that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised, and her magnificence should be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worshippeth.” Who were they worshipping? The great goddess Diana. And when they knew Paul was a Jew, “all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.”

That goddess worship ran through Corinth and that whole area. Some of those women repented, so to speak, came into the church, and brought that goddess spirit with them. That whole feminist movement is the same spirit, back today, and sisters do not want to admit that is the spirit they are rolling in. Feminism has been normalized to where a man has to whisper in his own house.

So when there are issues in your household, it is because you allowed confusion to breach: you let feminism and pride in and did not stop them at the door. If you are scared of your wife, brother, take the purple shirt off; you cannot cast down the lies of the nations and bring us out of captivity if you are scared to deal with your wife at home. The head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is the man; that is the divine order, and God is not the author of confusion.

note.label: The Iranians & The Ephesians

precepts.why:
“And the same time there arose no small stir about that way.” What way is this? Christ answers it: “I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.” The way that Ephesus was stirred up about, the thing that caused a huge commotion in that city, was Christ himself.

They had a problem with Christ because a whole city was given to witchcraft. Ephesus owed its fame to the temple of Diana, and the “curious arts” practised there were the magical arts of the Ephesian conjurers. When Paul came preaching Christ, “many that believed came, and confessed, and shewed their deeds”, and those who used curious arts brought their books of witchcraft together and burned them before all men, fifty thousand pieces of silver worth. “So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed.”

That is what stirred the city. Demetrius the silversmith, “which made silver shrines for Diana”, called the craftsmen together and told them “by this craft we have our wealth”, and that Paul had “persuaded and turned away much people, saying that they be no gods, which are made with hands.” People were repenting and turning away from their witchcraft, and that put both the craftsmen’s living and the temple of “the great goddess Diana” in danger. Diana, with all the breasts on her, goes into fertility: satanic worship at the end of the day.

So the stir “about that way” was a city given over to idolatry and sorcery fighting against Christ, the only way to the Father. There is no salvation without him, and the same call goes out to our people now: repent from the idolatry, the fornication and the lasciviousness, and come to the way.

note.label: | SABBATH EVENING CLASS: The Third Kingdom of Babylon

precepts.why:
Remember what you just read in Acts 19 about Diana throughout all Asia: this is what it’s talking about. Thyatira is right there in Asia Minor. “Unto the angel of the church in Thyatira write; These things saith the Son of God”. Watch this: “I have a few things against thee, because thou sufferest that woman Jezebel, which calleth herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce my servants to commit fornication”.

Why do you think she was running her mouth in the church? Because they were worshipping Diana. She came from that, but she didn’t give it up. She came in with the same principles into the Most High’s flock and said the women can teach, the women can rule, and she brought all that filth with her. That’s what some of the sisters here in IUIC are doing; that’s what some of the sisters online are doing.

“And I gave her space to repent of her fornication; and she repented not.” Christ said he gave her space to repent, and she repented not. “Behold, I will cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of their deeds”: them that commit adultery with her means you brothers and sisters that join under the woman like that.

“And I will kill her children with death”. Wait, the Son of God said he’ll do what? Not my Jesus; I never learned that in church, that Jesus can kill people. Her children are not just our earthly kids but her followers; those are her kids. That means also men with no testicles that try to speak up for them against the Most High’s word: he gonna kill them too, you ball-less brothers. “And all the churches shall know that I am he which searcheth the reins and hearts: and I will give unto every one of you according to your works.”

note.label: | SABBATH EVENING CLASS: The Third Kingdom of Babylon

precepts.why:
Now we understand why Paul is getting on the woman, with Corinth right there on the map. “Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience, as also saith the law.” Why? Because he’s a misogynist? No. They were coming from worshipping the goddess Diana, that feminist mother goddess, and they were bringing those principles into Israel. Paul said no, that shall not stand here.

Christ had to threaten them too: I’m going to kill you with that crap you got, you women. The Son of God said that; that ain’t me saying that.

precepts.why:
Some of the other Israelite camps say we should not be blitzing the churches; their ministry is TikTok and YouTube, talking to a camera in the middle of nowhere. That is not what we do. We go out there for the love of the people, to find them and bring the word to them.

“And he went into the synagogue, and spake boldly for the space of three months, disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God. But when divers were hardened, and believed not, but spake evil of that way before the multitude, he departed from them.” Some of our people were hardened and spoke evil of what he was teaching. “And this continued by the space of two years; so that all they which dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus.” He still taught regardless.

Verse 19: “Many of them also which used curious arts brought their books together, and burned them before all men: and they counted the price of them, and found it fifty thousand pieces of silver.” Because of the constant teaching, even with people who turned with an evil heart, the people destroyed their pagan books, worth what would be millions today.

note.label: Must Be Hated To Be Heard! The Price Of Speaking Truth To Modern Day Christians

precepts.why:
It had to be a real sum, because it set their trade in danger: “So that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised, and her magnificence should be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worshippeth.” Ephesus was a tourist spot; they sold their idols and their books, and this man turned it upside down. Some of the people were hardened, so he separated them: we will work with these, because those are no good. That is your church folks and your pastors today. We will work with some of the people from the 2819 Church, but others will turn and join with the white man against us like the coons they are.

What happens when we teach this word and people stop tithing, stop eating pork, women stop wearing pants, men stop wearing dresses, people stop stealing and murdering? When we affect the economy, they will come. We have not yet seen the wrath of Esau. That is when they will try to put us to death, and some brothers will find out how small their faith is.

“And when they heard these sayings, they were full of wrath, and cried out, saying, Great is Diana of the Ephesians. And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul’s companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.” Full of wrath means violence; to take them they had to restrain them and hit them.

“And when Paul would have entered in unto the people, the disciples suffered him not.” Paul did not run and leave them; he tried to go in after his brother. “And certain of the chief of Asia, which were his friends, sent unto him, desiring him that he would not adventure himself into the theatre.” Paul understood he could not leave his brother out there facing death. He signed up for this knowing he could lose his life, and we signed up knowing we can never leave a brother out there. This is the condition of the battle.

The people last week were close to erupting; God held them off. They have a disdain for the strong, righteous, alpha black man. They will take the alpha male from prison, but not us. They hate us, and that is okay.

note.label: Identifying Babylon The Great

precepts.why:
Somebody might try to use Acts 19. Paul “went into the synagogue, and spake boldly for the space of three months, disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God. But when divers were hardened, and believed not, but spake evil of that way before the multitude, he departed from them, and separated the disciples, disputing daily in the school of one Tyrannus.”

That disputing didn’t mean arguing back and forth. The other translations put it as discussions, and reasoning daily, in the lecture hall of Tyrannus. And when they were hardened and spoke evil of the way, Paul left them and took the disciples with him.

And there’s an open challenge to all the camps that say they’re righteous before the Lord: travel to another country where we’re not teaching, teach the Bible and establish something there. Crickets. All they know how to do is slander.
